chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 263 – Ji Ning Strikes Treasure Vault Gold with 180k+ Artifacts
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers a hidden treasure vault with over 180,000 magic treasures left by a Celestial Immortal. A windfall that shifts his cultivation resources from poverty to paradise.
og_title: Desolate Era: The Treasure Hall Windfall
og_description: Ji Ning stumbles upon a Celestial Immortal’s hidden stash—over 180,000 artifacts. His fortunes have just taken a quantum leap.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch 263: The Big Loot Drop
twitter_description: Ji Ning finds a treasure vault with 180k+ artifacts. Even the shelves are worth more than a kingdom.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare, valuable wood used for crafting furniture and storage items in the Three Realms. One jin is worth one tael of Primordial Liquid, making even the shelves in a Celestial Immortal’s treasure vault a fortune in themselves.
One of the five sub-palaces of Immortal Wu Jiang’s immortal estate. It served as a storage and reward facility for the Celestial Immortal’s tribe, containing vast numbers of graded magic treasures.

The seventh major realm of Ki Refining, achieved by surviving the Heavenly Tribulation. A Celestial Immortal is no longer bound by the Five Elements and possesses a lifespan that is effectively eternal within the Three Realms.

A cultivator who failed their Heavenly Tribulation but survived by abandoning their physical body. They face periodic, ever-strengthening tribulations roughly every ten to fifty thousand years, making their existence a constant struggle for survival.

The sixth major realm of Ki Refining, achieved by reaching the peak of the Void stage and preparing for the Heavenly Tribulation. Despite their immense power, they have not yet transcended mortal lifespan limitations.
